snippet.title: Spell Casting Meowgically Enhanced Edition Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam:  http://store.steampowered.com/app/522990

Itchio: https://gordgames.itch.io/spell-casting

Interested in becoming a Wizard?  Here at the Magical Education Of Wizards School (MEOWS) we have a Distance Education Program!  Learn Spells in the comfort of your home!

Spell Casting is a line drawing puzzle game in which you cast spells by tracing out the patterns in the spell books using your mouse (or finger if using a touchscreen laptop / tablet). Earn a 3 star rating in each practice spell to unlock the exam for that book and unlock new books by pass the exam!  The exams require practice and memorization as you no longer can see the spell's path, only dots which require connection.

Spell Casting is fun for all ages and family friendly. Play just for fun or try to achieve 5 stars in all the spells and exams.

Spell Casting supports accessibility by supporting touch screen tablet devices and also allows you to hold down the Space Bar when drawing instead of clicking the mouse.

"If you're looking to play something together as a family, this is good stuff." - Indiegames.com

"A great light-hearted puzzler that will test your memory and your dexterity." - alphabetagamer.com 

Find out more at http://gordonlittle.ca/games/spell-casting/
